rules.text:
Look: Earmark's own ledger identity, not the shared clone tokens. D-42 palette (paper #f7f6f2, ink #1c1b18, green #1f5f4a), a deep-green sidebar (#173f33), square 3–4 px corners, flat ruled cards, money in monospace, and a dog-eared corner on what's been earmarked (Available, published notes, the logo). Outcomes stay word → glyph → colour.

Copy and codes come from docs/DEMO.md and the pages on main.

[Bracketed] values are placeholders: committed, actual and available are derived from seed rows and weren't computed for this mockup. Planned figures, thresholds, seats and names are the real seed.
